A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GainLoRA and provide readable methods, equations, experiments, figures and appendices. Content can be matched reliably despite reordered sections and renumbered displays.

before.justification: v1 reports original continual-learning experiments, ablations, gating analyses and rehearsal results, alongside explicitly attributed baseline results.

after.justification: v2 retains original experiments and adds Llama-3-8B results and Llama-2-7B gating-output analyses.

M1.justification: The main GainLoRA architecture, constraints and training procedure remain unchanged. However, v2 removes the rehearsal adaptation in v1 Appendix C.7, which replaced the constraints with an additional gate-output loss on replay samples.

E1.justification: Both versions cover the same SuperNI, Long Sequence, TRACE and six general-capability evaluation tasks. Adding Llama-3 changes the model configuration; removing the rehearsal experiment changes the training procedure on retained task coverage.

E2.justification: The SAPT-LoRA comparison disappears with v1 Appendix C.7 and Table 14, although SAPT remains cited. Comparator membership in the retained experiments, including L2P, DualPrompt and CODA-Prompt, is unchanged.

E3.justification: v2 adds Llama-3-8B evaluation on SuperNI Orders 1 and 2 and removes the synthetic-replay protocol. Existing task orders, metrics, ranks, training epochs and optimizer settings remain unchanged. The AP/FT formulas move from Appendix B.1 into Section 4.1 without changing.

E4.justification: v2 Figure 4 extends the gating-output analysis from T5-Large to Llama-2-7B, testing whether old-task gate outputs remain near zero on another backbone. The rehearsal-applicability study is removed. Constraint, activation-function, width, depth and rank analyses are retained.

E5.justification: v2 removes the main-results standard-deviation tables in v1 Appendix C.3, Tables 9–11, and strips uncertainty values from the retained activation-function and update-strategy tables. Both versions still state three runs with different seeds, and Figure 2 retains shaded bands. The new checklist nevertheless claims that Appendix C provides standard deviations.

E6.justification: v2 adds Llama-3-8B performance and resource results, adds Llama-2 gating distributions, and removes replay outcomes. All three adapted CV-baseline scores change; for example, CODA-Prompt AP/FT changes from 10.80/16.15 in v1 Table 18 to 19.28/14.62 in v2 Table 14. Retained core GainLoRA means are unchanged. New Llama-3 GainLoRA (O-LoRA) parameter reporting conflicts: approximately 2.51M in Figure 3 versus 2.12M in Appendix B.4.5.

T1.justification: Section 3.2.2 adds an explicit orthogonality derivation in v2 Equation 11, where v1 relied on cited results. Proposition 3.1 and its Appendix A.3 induction proof retain the same substance; task-indexed activation notation mainly clarifies the existing mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same central contributions: gated integration of expanding LoRA branches, reduced forgetting and superior benchmark performance. Changing LM terminology to LLM and adding supporting experiments do not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: The limitations replace v1's unresolved forward/backward knowledge-transfer question with an explicit focus on non-overlapping tasks and uncertainty about overlapping-task scenarios. The warning about accumulating constraints remains. Removing Appendix C.7 also removes the discussion of applicability to rehearsal.

D1.justification: v2 Appendix B.4.5 supplies Llama-3 projection shapes, gating dimensions and parameter calculations. Appendix C.7 newly describes key/value prompt insertion and position-bias padding for CV baselines, while omitting v1's mean-query and validation-tuning account. These documentation changes do not establish an implementation change. Hardware, general hyperparameters and the code URL are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds four references covering Llama-3, two blurry-task-boundary studies and continual learning with mixtures of adapters. Section 2.1 expands its discussion of prompt-based methods, but GainLoRA's central positioning relative to existing LoRA methods remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Terminology, activation indexing and several passages are edited locally. Metric definitions move into the main text, references move before the appendices, and acknowledgments and a NeurIPS checklist are added. The scientific narrative and main section organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: The visual presentation is substantially reorganized: Figure 1 is relaid out, the combined parameter/gating Figure 3 becomes separate expanded Figures 3 and 4, and Table 3 changes to stacked model groups. Four appendix tables disappear, retained uncertainty-bearing tables are reformatted, and the resource table gains Llama-3 rows.

improvement.justification: Llama-3 evaluation, additional gating evidence and the projection derivation provide useful gains. However, removing previously reported standard deviations weakens assessment of result reliability, while the new checklist incorrectly claims those appendix statistics remain available. The new parameter-count inconsistency adds another reporting defect. With the central method and retained benchmark means unchanged, these losses outweigh the limited additions.
